structural_form: signups = base*L*(mkt/refmkt)^mktexp*(price/refprice)^elast*coupling; customers rolls forward with price-sensitive churn; revenue = customers*acv*price; latent demand L is AR(1) and UNOBSERVED.
decision: Choose, per segment, a constant MARKETING level (usd/quarter) and a PRICE multiplier (1.0 = reference) for each of the 8 held-out quarters.

budget_constraint.note: sum of per-segment marketing must be <= cap

price_bounds_note: the price multiplier is only calibrated in [0.7, 1.3] and is CLAMPED to that band; values outside are not meaningful (the model is not valid there)
objective: maximize total expected gross profit over the held-out horizon
starting_state_note: customers at the end of history are given in history.csv; latent demand continues from its (unobserved) end state
